content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify all relevant project files, especially candidate_specs.md and any documents containing RPC timing simulation results or simulation instructions for gas mixtures and gap sizes."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read candidate_specs.md. Extract the three allowed mixture candidates, their component fractions, and their GWP100 values. Record each candidate's GWP100 as numeric results, and mark which candidates satisfy the hard GWP100 <= 150 constraint."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the simulation-related document(s) found in s1. Determine the simulated time resolution for each allowed candidate over gas gaps between 1 and 3 mm, or the method/table needed to obtain those values. Record the numeric time resolution values for each candidate-gap combination considered."},{"id":"s4","description":"Filter the evaluated designs to those satisfying both hard requirements: GWP100 <= 150 and time resolution <= 1.5 ns, with gas gap in the 1 to 3 mm range. Among feasible designs, identify the one with the lowest simulated time resolution. Record the winning candidate index, gas gap in mm, time resolution in ns, and GWP100 as numeric results."},{"id":"s5","description":"If there is a tie or near-tie in best time resolution, use any project-document guidance on preferred operating gap, robustness, or detector-upgrade constraints to select one final design. Record the final recommended candidate index and gas gap as numeric results for the reporting module."}]}
